parts.title: Places to study
questions: Where do you usually go when you need to concentrate?
How has your preferred place to study changed?
What kinds of sounds help or interrupt your work?
Do you prefer a place where other people are also studying?

parts.title: Individual talk
parts.cue: Describe a public place where you were able to learn or work well.
questions: Explain what you went there to do.
Describe a feature that helped you concentrate.
Explain whether you would use the place again.

parts.title: Discussion
questions: How can public spaces support people who cannot study comfortably at home?
What problems can arise when quiet work and group activities share a building?
Who should decide the rules for shared study spaces?
How might a city tell whether a new learning space serves the people who need it?
